32: /** Thrown when a library write's `updated_at` precondition doesn't match — i.e. someone else
33:  *  saved between this request's read and its write. `status` is read by index.ts's error
34:  *  middleware, same as the shared `CampaignArchivedError` family. */
35: export class LibraryConflictError extends Error {
36:   readonly status = 409;
37:   constructor() {
38:     super('Someone else saved the library while you were editing. Reload and reapply your change.');
39:   }
40: }
41: 
42: /** Every library write is a read-modify-write of the *entire* 16-key blob, so without a
43:  *  precondition two admins editing unrelated records in unrelated collections silently clobber
44:  *  each other — last writer wins, and the changelog records both as successful. `version` is the
45:  *  row's `updated_at` exactly as Postgres returned it; hand it back to `saveLibrary` to make the
46:  *  write conditional.
47:  *
48:  *  Caveat worth knowing: this is millisecond-resolution time, not a monotonic counter, so two
49:  *  writes landing inside the same millisecond could both pass the check. Closing that properly
50:  *  needs a real version column and a migration; for a tool with a handful of admins the time
51:  *  precondition removes the realistic window, and it needs no schema change. */
52: export async function getLibraryWithVersion(): Promise<{ library: Library; version: string }> {
53:   const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('library').select('data, updated_at').eq('id', 'singleton').maybeSingle();
54:   if (error) throw error;
55:   if (!data) throw new Error('Library not seeded');
56:   const raw = data.data as Library;
57:   const version = data.updated_at as string;
58:   const normalized = normalizeLibrary(raw);
59:   // Self-heal a Library row missing a field added after it was seeded, so future reads don't
60:   // need to repeat this — same pattern as getSheet's Recoveries/Scars backfill. Compares every
61:   // key rather than the six this used to name by hand: villains/npcs/locations (0.35.0) and
62:   // loadTiers were all added later and were never in that list, so a row missing one of them
63:   // re-normalized on every single read and never healed.
64:   const healed = (Object.keys(normalized) as (keyof Library)[]).some((k) => normalized[k] !== raw[k]);
65:   if (healed) {
66:     try {
67:       return { library: normalized, version: await saveLibrary(normalized, version) };
68:     } catch (err) {
69:       // Another request healed it first. Ours is equivalent, so serve it and let the caller's
70:       // own write fail its precondition if it has one — never fail a *read* over this.
71:       if (!(err instanceof LibraryConflictError)) throw err;
72:     }
73:   }
74:   return { library: normalized, version };
75: }
